The Traveling Nomad

The Olympus stands as our most sought-after adventure van, blending off-grid performance with clean, minimalist interior design. Equipped with advanced lithium power and a high-output solar system, it's built for freedom without sacrificing comfort.

BUILD
FEATURES

Kitchen Electricity Plumbing Heating/Cooling Aesthetic Storage Misc

Kitchen

  • Durable Acacia butcher block countertop with a natural finish
  • Portable single or built-in double burner induction cooktop
  • Undermount stainless steel sink with hot/cold water faucet
  • 3 cubic foot fridge with integrated freezer for food storage

Electricity

  • 400W solar array with 40A MPPT charger, installed if space allows
  • 400Ah lithium iron battery bank designed for extended off-grid use
  • 2500W pure sine inverter and charger to handle all onboard electronics
  • Four 110V outlets paired with USB-A and USB-C charging ports
  • External shore plug-in to draw power when parked at hookups
  • 40A DC-DC charger to replenish batteries while driving

Plumbing

  • 33-gallon fresh water tank for multi-day van life use

  • Laveo dry flush toilet with odor-free disposable cartridge system
  • Indoor wet-bath with integrated shower and compact toilet setup
  • 4-gallon electric heater for reliable hot water access
  • Rear-door outdoor shower for quick rinse after hikes or surf sessions

Heating/cooling

  • Full insulation package designed for year-round temperature control
  • Maxxair Deluxe roof fan with remote for airflow and ventilation
  • 12V Nomadic rooftop A/C unit with remote climate adjustment
  • Espar cabin heater powered by diesel or gasoline, built for cold-weather travel

Aesthetic

  • Painted shiplap walls for a clean, cabin-inspired interior finish
  • Stained natural wood ceiling adding warmth and character overhead
  • Durable vinyl flooring with wood grain texture for a refined, home-like look

Storage

  • Four overhead cabinets, layout-dependent for optimized upper storage
  • Double-door cabinet beneath counter for bulkier kitchen essentials
  • Spacious under-bed garage area for large gear and equipment
  • Smooth-slide drawer cabinet for organized under-counter storage
  • Additional cabinet space below counter for daily-use items and tools

misc

  • Full-size memory foam bed for comfort on extended trips
  • Dimmable recessed LED ceiling lights for customizable interior lighting
  • Swivel driver and passenger seats for flexible cabin use
  • Carbon monoxide detector and mounted fire extinguisher for safety
  • Lagun adjustable swivel table for dining or workstation setup
  • Side window installed for added light and airflow
  • Roof rack with ladder for gear storage and roof access
  • Sliding door T-vent window for controlled ventilation
  • Secondary bunk window installed for extra visibility and airflow

interior HIGHLIGHTS

EXTERIOR UPGRADES

PACKAGE UPGRADES

Four Peaks Package

Designed for small families or travel partners, this layout includes foldable jump seats and an additional bed perfect for adventures with more people.

Premium Insulation Package

Get superior warmth and natural moisture control with Havelock wool insulation a sustainable solution for year-round vanlife comfort.

Necessities Off Road Package

Essential upgrades like side steps, perimeter lighting, and a front-mounted light bar make off-road navigation safer and more accessible.

Advanced Off Road Package

Take your build to the next level with a lift kit, rock sliders, bumper, spare tire carrier, and full lighting built for extreme trails and backcountry exploration.

Advanced Interior Light Package

The advanced interior lighting package with a light bar and perimeter lighting enhances visibility, ambiance, and functionality for an immersive driving experience.

Advanced Exterior Light Package

Light bar and perimeter lighting

Wheels and Tires Package

Choose from all-terrain tires, custom rims, and durable wheels to improve your grip, stance, and style across rugged routes.

Window Cover Package

Van Essentials covers offer full privacy, sun protection, and thermal regulation a stealth camping must-have for comfort and security.
